# Resource footprints

Environmental and socio-economic footprints of 44 countries and 5 rest-of-world regions, 1995-2024, calculated with EXIOBASE 3.11.3.

- [Footprint explorer](https://resourcefootprints.com/explorer): production-based, consumption-based and import-embodied results for 22 indicators, by region and by sector group.

Licence: results derived from EXIOBASE, published with attribution under section (b) of the EXIOBASE licence. See https://resourcefootprints.com/#licence
